technical.summary: Bullish momentum with strong trend confirmation (ADX 37.59, supertrend, hull flip) but overbought conditions (StochRSI, Williams %R) and negative volume signals (CMF, AO) create execution risk; moderate swing entry on pullback preferred.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 77 days create a low-conviction setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (29 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no senior conviction; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (399.36) with imminent NFP event in 2 days creates acute macro stress; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 77 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical momentum (ADX 37.59, supertrend bullish, hull flip, price above major MAs) with contrarian buy signal in extreme fear regime (VIX crisis) offers asymmetric risk/reward on pullback.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought conditions (StochRSI, Williams %R), negative volume signals (CMF, AO), zero fundamental conviction, imminent NFP event in 2 days, and macro crisis environment (VIX 399.36) create execution risk that outweighs technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum is strong (ADX 37.59, supertrend bullish, hull flip) and contrarian setup in extreme fear presents asymmetric opportunity, but overbought conditions and negative volume signals create poor entry quality at resistance.
decision.primary_risk: Imminent NFP event in 2 days combined with VIX crisis regime (399.36) and earnings in 77 days creates compounding macro and event risk that negates technical setup; overbought oscillators signal mean reversion risk.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents bullish, but fundamental and risk agents strongly bearish; debate winner is bear with medium confidence.
